rules.headlineKpis: Latest complete observation; the global timeframe affects comparison windows and charts, not the observation date.
rules.historicalPricing: Use observation-date USD values from the source. Current prices are never retroactively applied without an explicit label.
rules.missingValues: Null means unavailable or unsupported. Null values are never converted to zero.
rules.partialDay: Current UTC day is marked partial and excluded from period-over-period comparisons.

metrics.label: Protocol TVL
metrics.definition: Value locked in Avalanche protocols tracked by DeFiLlama, excluding centralized exchanges and double-counted borrowed balances.
metrics.formula: DeFiLlama Avalanche chain TVL at each daily observation.
metrics.limitations: Protocol adapter methodology and coverage can change retroactively.

metrics.label: Gross Protocol-Adapter TVL
metrics.definition: Current Avalanche TVL reported by individual protocol adapters, grouped for non-additive comparison.
metrics.formula: Group positive Avalanche protocol-adapter TVL by category. Display each category independently beside authoritative chain TVL; never sum the groups or interpret them as chain-TVL shares.
metrics.limitations: Vaults, allocators, wrappers, RWA structures, and their underlying protocols can represent overlapping capital.

metrics.label: Stablecoin Market Cap
metrics.definition: USD value of ordinary stablecoins circulating on Avalanche.
metrics.formula: Sum totalCirculatingUSD; tokenized funds such as BUIDL and yield wrappers are excluded.
metrics.limitations: Supply adapters may lag and bridged representations depend on source classification.

metrics.label: Tokenized Asset Value
metrics.definition: Current value attributable to the registry-authenticated Avalanche tokenized-asset contracts, excluding ordinary stablecoins.
metrics.formula: Sum totalSupply / 10^tokenDecimals × validated RedStone answer / 10^feedDecimals for all four exact Avalanche contracts. Incomplete baskets expose a partial subtotal separately; the four-asset headline is unavailable.
metrics.cadence: Five-minute source refresh; published within one minute
metrics.limitations: BUIDL/VBILL/ACRED use fundamental NAV; SECZ uses end-of-day equity price, not NAV or a live quote. Source timestamps remain independent. Hard-expired values are excluded. Adapter TVL and comparator estimates are non-additive.

metrics.label: Broader RWA Adapter TVL
metrics.definition: Avalanche TVL reported by all positive DeFiLlama protocol adapters categorized as RWA.
metrics.formula: Sum positive Avalanche chain TVL for RWA protocol adapters and report it separately from verified token-contract value.
metrics.limitations: The adapter universe can include vaults, issuers, wrappers, and structures outside the verified contract registry and can overlap economically.

metrics.label: Daily Transactions
metrics.definition: Successful and failed user and system transactions included in C-Chain blocks during a UTC day.
metrics.formula: Count distinct transaction hashes in indexed blocks.
metrics.limitations: Coverage before the local archive start is not displayed.

metrics.label: Distinct transaction senders (transaction.from)
metrics.definition: Distinct transaction senders included on C-Chain during a UTC day.
metrics.formula: count(distinct lower(from_address)); contract recipients are not counted solely for receiving.
metrics.limitations: Addresses are not deduplicated into users. Avalanche activeSenders may also infer senders from token-transfer logs and is not expected to match this narrower scope.

metrics.label: Top-level contract-creation transactions
metrics.definition: Included transactions with no destination address.
metrics.formula: Count transactions where to_address is null or empty.
metrics.limitations: Internal CREATE, CREATE2, and CREATE3 trace activity is not included; do not compare directly with trace-based totals without normalizing scope.

metrics.label: Transaction Failure Rate
metrics.definition: Share of included transactions whose receipt status is failed.
metrics.formula: failed transaction count / transaction count * 100.
metrics.limitations: Reverted internal calls inside a successful outer transaction are not counted.

metrics.label: Average Throughput
metrics.definition: Average included transactions per elapsed UTC day.
metrics.formula: daily transaction count / 86,400; partial days use elapsed seconds and are labeled partial.
metrics.limitations: Daily mean is not peak throughput.

metrics.label: Transaction Fees Burned
metrics.definition: C-Chain transaction fees destroyed under Avalanche fee mechanics.
metrics.formula: sum(gas_used * effective_gas_price); both base and priority portions are burned on C-Chain.
metrics.limitations: Displayed cumulative totals are coverage-window totals, not lifetime totals.

metrics.label: DEX Volume
metrics.definition: Spot swap volume attributed by protocol adapters on Avalanche.
metrics.formula: DeFiLlama daily DEX volume; adapters are summed once by protocol.
metrics.limitations: Aggregator routes are excluded when adapters identify them, but protocol adapter coverage is not uniform.

metrics.label: Spot DEX adapter TVL proxy
metrics.definition: Positive Avalanche TVL reported by DeFiLlama protocols in its broader Dexs category; this is a proxy, not measured immediately usable AMM liquidity.
metrics.formula: Sum current Avalanche protocol TVL for registry entries categorized Spot DEX.
metrics.limitations: The Dexs category is broader than pure AMMs and protocol TVL may include staking or non-trading balances. The UI discloses the Top 30 visible rows and omitted tail.

metrics.label: Gross Supplied Assets
metrics.definition: Tracked eligible priced lending claims across Aave V3/V4, BENQI, Euler V2, Silo V2 and V3. Gross supply is distinct from borrowed, liquid cash and secondary DeFiLlama net TVL.
metrics.formula: Sum only eligible source-backed market fields; Aave V4 hubs once, never additive spokes or allocator vaults. Each field has its own known/eligible coverage.
metrics.cadence: Gateway materializer every 5 minutes; dashboard consumer every minute; stale after 15 minutes.
metrics.limitations: Not a complete Avalanche lending census. Hidden, deprecated, impaired and nonadditive rows are excluded. Missing prices or fields remain null; partial subtotals are explicitly identified.

metrics.label: Total Borrowed
metrics.definition: Explicit outstanding debt for eligible tracked native markets, with field-specific coverage.
metrics.formula: Sum reported eligible debt, never gross supply minus liquid cash.
metrics.limitations: Aave V3 collateral-only reserves have missing borrowing fields. Partial debt coverage is not a complete protocol or chain total.

metrics.label: AVAX Market Capitalization
metrics.definition: Current market value of circulating AVAX reported by an independent market-data provider.
metrics.formula: Provider circulating supply multiplied by current AVAX USD price.
metrics.limitations: Market cap depends on provider supply methodology; CoinPaprika is used when CoinGecko is rate limited.

metrics.label: Ecosystem Asset Landscape
metrics.definition: Side-by-side current values for AVAX market cap, ordinary stablecoins, and verified tokenized assets.
metrics.formula: Display the independently calculated category totals without summing them into an ecosystem total.
metrics.limitations: Categories describe different accounting concepts and may overlap economically, so the chart is comparative rather than additive.

metrics.label: Avalanche Bridge TVL
metrics.definition: Current Avalanche value attributed to protocols categorized as bridges.
metrics.formula: Sum positive Avalanche chain TVL for named bridge protocol adapters.
metrics.limitations: Adapter balances do not measure flow, capacity, redeemability, security, or operational health. Status is Unknown unless a separate official source URL and checked-at timestamp support it.

metrics.label: Average and Median Transaction Cost
metrics.definition: Mean or median fee paid by included C-Chain transactions in a complete UTC day.
metrics.formula: Per transaction gas_used multiplied by effective_gas_price, divided by 1e18; then mean or median.
metrics.limitations: USD history is not asserted without observation-date AVAX prices.

metrics.label: Average Gas Price
metrics.definition: Mean effective gas price across included C-Chain transactions in a complete UTC day.
metrics.formula: avg(effective_gas_price) / 1e9.
metrics.limitations: A transaction-weighted mean differs from a time-weighted base-fee series.

metrics.label: Average Block Utilization
metrics.definition: Mean share of each C-Chain block gas limit consumed during a complete UTC day.
metrics.formula: avg(block gas_used / block gas_limit) * 100.
metrics.limitations: Gas-limit utilization is not equivalent to transaction-capacity utilization.

metrics.label: Throughput and Failure Rate
metrics.definition: Daily average transaction throughput shown alongside the outer-transaction failure share.
metrics.formula: transactions / 86,400 and failed transactions / transactions * 100.
metrics.limitations: Daily TPS is not peak throughput; internal call reverts are not separately counted.

metrics.label: 30-day annualized run rate
metrics.definition: Recent average daily C-Chain fee burn extrapolated to 365 days.
metrics.formula: Displayed trailing 30-day average daily C-Chain burn multiplied by 365.
metrics.limitations: An annualized run rate is not a forecast and the 30-day window is partial until 30 observations exist.

metrics.label: Primary Network Supply Ledger
metrics.definition: Current total AVAX supply and cumulative net supply added since the 360 million AVAX genesis unlock.
metrics.formula: Current total supply = 360M genesis unlock + cumulative staking rewards minted - cumulative P-, C-, and X-Chain transaction fees burned. Net supply since genesis = current total supply - genesis unlock.
metrics.limitations: This is a current cumulative ledger, not a historical issuance time series. The dashboard does not infer validator operating expenses or profit.

metrics.label: Staking Rewards Minted
metrics.definition: Cumulative AVAX minted by the Primary Network protocol as staking rewards.
metrics.formula: Use the official Data API totalRewards field without converting transaction fees into validator revenue.
metrics.limitations: The cumulative total is not the same as current validator income, annual reward rate, or realized delegation fee revenue.

metrics.label: Primary Network Fees Burned
metrics.definition: Cumulative AVAX destroyed by transaction fees on the P-, C-, and X-Chains.
metrics.formula: totalPBurned + totalCBurned + totalXBurned from the official Avalanche Data API.
metrics.limitations: The all-time Primary Network total is distinct from the dashboard's locally indexed C-Chain coverage-window burn.

metrics.label: Unsupported Network Economics
metrics.definition: Validator operating cost, gross profit, and margin concepts that cannot currently be reproduced defensibly for the Primary Network or C-Chain.
metrics.formula: No value is calculated; the machine value remains null.
metrics.limitations: Private validator costs remain outside verified coverage. Current cumulative supply accounting is published separately from these unsupported profitability concepts.

metrics.label: Verified Tokenized Asset Count
metrics.definition: Number of Avalanche token contracts whose issuance and backing classification are verified in the registry.
metrics.formula: Count registry contracts with role Token and an issuer-backed RWA classification.
metrics.limitations: Bridged representations, ordinary stablecoins, and unverified claims are excluded.

metrics.label: Summed Contract Addresses
metrics.definition: Current explorer-reported holder addresses summed across verified tokenized-asset contracts.
metrics.formula: Sum current token holder count for each verified token contract.
metrics.limitations: Exact-contract address counts summed across the four assets, not unique wallets or investors. Retained observations keep their original timestamps.

metrics.label: Tokenized Asset Mint and Burn
metrics.definition: Transfer events from or to the zero address for a selected verified token contract.
metrics.formula: Sum Transfer values with from zero for mints and to zero for burns, divided by on-chain token decimals.
metrics.limitations: Token units are not converted to historical USD without observation-date NAV.

metrics.label: Tokenized Asset DEX Volume
metrics.definition: Direct spot swap volume for verified tokenized assets.
metrics.formula: No value is calculated until verified pool events can be deduplicated across direct, multi-hop, and internal operations.
metrics.limitations: The metric remains null under current pool-registry coverage.

metrics.label: Available Lending Liquidity
metrics.definition: Source-reported liquid cash in eligible tracked markets; not a promise of borrowing or immediate withdrawal capacity.
metrics.formula: Sum eligible protocol-native liquid-cash values; do not derive it from supply minus debt.
metrics.limitations: Silo protected collateral is separate and not borrowable. Aave V4 spoke borrow capacity is not hub cash. Reserves, caps, impairment and pauses may constrain usable liquidity.

metrics.label: Current Lending Market Rates
metrics.unit: percent APR or APY, explicitly labeled per row
metrics.definition: Source-reported base supply and borrow rates for Avalanche Aave V3/V4, BENQI, Euler V2, Silo V2 and V3. Each row preserves APR or APY basis.
metrics.formula: Use the canonical materializer source rate and declared scaling; incentives are separate and unavailable when unreported.
metrics.limitations: The current Euler source may omit rates even when balances are available. No older differently timed rates, incentive zeros or inferred APYs fill missing observations. Variable rates are observations, not forecasts.

metrics.label: Factory Vault Assets
metrics.definition: Separate nonadditive allocator-vault accounting when a canonical vault materialization is supplied.
metrics.formula: Only a verified canonical vault inventory may populate this lane.
metrics.limitations: Currently unavailable if no canonical allocator-vault inventory is supplied. Underlying lending-market assets must not be counted again as allocator vault assets.

metrics.label: Lending Liquidation Activity
metrics.definition: Dated retained liquidation observations for Aave V3/V4, BENQI and Euler; Silo hook/generation coverage is unverified and quarantined.
metrics.formula: Observed unique transaction/log pairs in the explicitly dated retained window; USD values are historical token-price estimates, not necessarily cash repaid.
metrics.cadence: Retained historical snapshot; no current complete event feed claimed.
metrics.limitations: Partial, unverified registry and event-window coverage; BENQI isolated markets and Silo generations are not complete. No exact global count, exhaustive zero or current rolling 30-day claim. Aave liquidator attribution is withheld.

metrics.label: Cross-Source Verification
metrics.definition: A scope-aware comparison between an Observatory metric and a separately fetched primary, independent, or same-provider consistency value.
metrics.formula: variance percent = (Observatory value - comparator value) / abs(comparator value) * 100. Only exact-scope checks are scored; context-only or unavailable values never pass or fail.
metrics.limitations: The badge count is derived from passing scored ledger rows. It is scope-limited and does not certify all stablecoin, DEX architecture, bridge-health, lending-market, rate, vault, liquidation, or deployment-history data. Same-provider checks are consistency checks, not independent verification.
